| [Equipment integration — assessment and guidance](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Two entry routes to one protocol for connecting machines (Lane 1b order and connect, Lane 3b new connector - the former Information Integration Service lane). Assessment: inventory a plant's or wave's machines, decide per machine the integration concept and connector, plan, size and sequence the wave (formerly od-machine-integration-plan). Guidance: route one assessed machine to the IIoT Edge Platform or the Softing dataFEED Central OPC-UA Aggregation Server, walk the configuration, clear the preparation gates, take the right fallback, and triage a machine that will not connect (formerly od-barrier-triage). Use when a plant or wave starts, a machine's route is unclear, a use case is blocked for want of machine data, a machine is silent or blocked, or someone asks how to connect a Siemens / Rockwell / Beckhoff / B&R / Omron / Mitsubishi / Modbus / OPC-UA device, configure a dataFEED data source, or what to specify when ordering a new machine. Not for acceptance (od-acceptance-test). |
